details: Segment test S1 (crypto/Web3 SaaS+infra) vs S3 (hosting/VPS/proxy). Variable: segment only (same D0 template, same first-line rules). Primary: positive-reply rate per D0 (Touches notes start 'positive'). Min n 150 D0 per arm. End 2026-11-01. SCALE S1 if both arms >=150 and S1 CI lower bound > S3 CI upper bound; KILL S3 if >=150 and S3 CI upper bound < 2%; else INCONCLUSIVE (extend once to 2026-11-15).

LinkedIn by hand to S1 finance leads (Aashmiin sends; notes by revops). Primary: held calls from LinkedIn. Min: 3 weeks. End 2026-11-18. SCALE if >=3 held calls with grade A-C pain; KILL if 0 held calls and >5 founder-hours/week.

Accounting-firm partner drafts (approved by Aashmiin, sent by her). Primary: partner conversations grade B+. Min n 15 approved+sent drafts. End 2026-11-01. ITERATE/SCALE if >=2 conversations; KILL channel for now if 0 replies after 15 sent; else INCONCLUSIVE.
